candidate.name: v45f4_one_pass_center_motion_head
candidate.architecture: frozen released TemporalUNet3D core plus 1,254-parameter center-residual/motion head

interpretation: The trained one-pass checkpoint is below the current frozen V45 sparse fallback on the same held-out smoke video and therefore fails promotion.
This is not a causal estimate of training harm: the incumbent uses the released eight-view D4 execution while the candidate uses one view, and no zero-head one-view control was run.

The sparse GEFF supervision is limited and the candidate trained a detector correction while the teacher term is dominant in the recorded loss; either the reduced view ensemble or the correction can explain the recall loss.
A fair zero-head one-view control may be created later for diagnosis, but no CV, audit, Kaggle submission, or additional training may proceed from this failed candidate.
